name: acfs
description: Version history for the files Codex changes: every Bash and apply_patch call becomes an acfs changeset you can diff and undo, merged into main when a turn ends. Runs on acfsd (Linux) or acfs-lite (macOS, Windows, any Linux).

interface.shortDescription: Checkpoint, diff and undo every file change
interface.longDescription: Records each Bash and apply_patch call as an acfs changeset in a copy-on-write store (acfsd on Linux, or an acfs-lite image on macOS, Windows and Linux), merges the work into main when a turn ends, and lets Codex list, diff and undo changes.
defaultPrompt: Show what you changed in this conversation
